name: Kakou Ton
source: She is the elder sister of the Kakou sisters and is also [url=/c219]Sou Sou's[/url] cousin and a commander of the Gi kingdom. She is strong on the battlefield, but is extremely straight forward in her thinking, shown by her lack of understanding the meanings of proverbs. Like many of Sou Sou's subordinates, she enjoys being complimented or acknowledged by her ruler.
